_comment: Custom Bekaert Fencing theme v6: vc-frontend 2.51.1 built from source. Barlow typeface (BekaertText is proprietary, not redistributable); preset default/assets/presets/bekaert.json (primary #01ADEF, accent #FF602C); pill buttons; light utility bar and light footer panel; FULL-BLEED hero with copy on the content column plus a CTA; wide 1800px content column so a wide monitor is not half empty; category card carousel with a 'Discover All' pill and arrows below; fullscreen catalog dropdown; footer columns grouped from the flat CMS menu list.
